name: Kick
label: Kick Public API v1 (+ v2 livestream list)
description: Official Kick Public API via OfficialApiNode. Base https://api.kick.com. Paths /public/v1/users, /public/v1/channels, /public/v1/users/livestreams, /public/v2/livestreams, /public/v1/chat. GET /public/v1/livestreams is deprecated (Kick OpenAPI). Bearer access_token. Supports EventSub-style webhooks. Never return stream keys. Official API only — do not scrape kick.com. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event). Docs: https://docs.kick.com · https://api.kick.com/swagger/doc.yaml
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_token here. Do not accept stream keys. Example: {"operation":"channel_get","slug":"example"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: user_get | channel_get | livestream_get (deprecated GET /public/v1/livestreams) | livestream_user | livestream_list | chat_send | trigger. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: id
schema.description: User id query for user_get. Official id.

schema.label: broadcaster_user_id
schema.description: Broadcaster user id for channel_get / livestream_get / chat_send.

schema.label: language_code
schema.description: Language filter for livestream_list. Example: en.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Chat message text for chat_send. Official content.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Never return stream.key or ingest URL even if the token has streamkey:read. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. livestream_get is Kick-deprecated; prefer livestream_user or livestream_list. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Kick OAuth 2.1 access token. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Empty → no HTTP.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
